# Metal Coatings


## Galvanizing and coating expertise for critical infrastructure


View Locations


[Request Information](https://www.azz.com/contact-us/)


For seven decades, AZZ has helped protect critical infrastructure, fabricated steel, and industrial assets from corrosion through industry-leading metal coating solutions. As North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing services, AZZ delivers comprehensive Metal Coatings capabilities that improve durability, reduce maintenance requirements, and support long-term infrastructure performance.


## Metal coating solutions for corrosion protection and performance


AZZ Metal Coatings offers galvanizing operations and specialized Surface Technologies to provide corrosion protection and metal finishing solutions for industrial, infrastructure, utility, transportation, and manufacturing applications. With one of the industry’s largest coating networks across the United States and Canada, AZZ helps customers improve project coordination, reduce logistical complexity, and support large-scale and multi-location projects with responsive service and flexible production capacity.


Core galvanizing capabilities include Hot-Dip Galvanizing and Spin Galvanizing, while AZZ Surface Technologies expands protection and performance through advanced coating, finishing, and surface preparation solutions tailored to specific environmental and performance requirements.


## Hot-dip galvanizing extends the service life of steel


AZZ Galvanizing helps extend the service life of fabricated steel by delivering proven corrosion protection for some of North America’s most demanding environments.[Hot-Dip Galvanizing](https://www.azz.com/hot-dip-galvanizing/) and[Spin Galvanizing](https://www.azz.com/spin-galvanizing/) are widely used across infrastructure, utility, transportation, industrial, and construction applications where durability, reliability, and reduced maintenance are critical.


Galvanized steel can provide decades of corrosion protection with minimal maintenance, helping reduce lifecycle costs, improve operational reliability, and extend asset performance. Galvanizing also supports sustainable construction initiatives through long service life, reduced material replacement, and the recyclability of both zinc and steel.


From structural steel, bridges, substations, utility poles, and transmission structures to transportation components and engineered assemblies, AZZ Galvanizing supports projects requiring dependable corrosion protection, large-scale capacity, and quick-turn project execution.


[Calculate Your Galvanizing Life-Cycle Costs →](https://www.azz.com/galvanizing-life-cycle-cost-calculator/)


## Surface technologies and value-added coating services


Beyond galvanizing, AZZ Surface Technologies provides specialized coating and finishing solutions designed to enhance corrosion protection, environmental resistance, durability, and appearance across a wide range of applications.


Capabilities include[duplex coating systems](https://www.azz.com/duplex-coating) ,[powder coating](https://www.azz.com/powder-coating) ,[plating](https://www.azz.com/plating) ,[e-coating](https://www.azz.com/e-coating) ,[wet coating](https://www.azz.com/wet-coating) ,[below-grade protection](https://www.azz.com/below-grade-coating) ,[surface preparation](https://www.azz.com/surface-prep) , and specialized[Mil-Spec](https://www.azz.com/Mil-Spec) applications. Together, these integrated value-added services help customers simplify coating coordination, improve production efficiency, and streamline finishing requirements through a single experienced provider.


AZZ also supports complex fabrication requirements and accelerated project schedules through operational flexibility, integrated processes, and one of the industry’s broadest service footprints. Customers benefit from responsive support, streamlined logistics, and coating expertise tailored to accelerated schedules and complex project requirements.


## Technology-driven operations and customer visibility


AZZ continues investing in technology, production systems, and process improvements that enhance efficiency, communication, visibility, and customer experience across its Metal Coatings network. Integrated digital workflows and operational systems help support faster decision-making, improved scheduling, streamlined coordination, and greater operational consistency across facilities.


A key part of this strategy is AZZ’s proprietary[Digital Galvanizing System](https://www.azz.com/digital-galvanizing-system/) (DGS), which provides near real-time order visibility, production tracking, status updates, and customer notifications throughout the galvanizing process. DGS helps improve efficiency while enhancing communication and responsiveness between AZZ teams and customers.


## Metal coating capabilities for the industries building North America


AZZ Metal Coatings supports[construction](https://www.azz.com/construction-market) ,[electrical](https://www.azz.com/electrical-market) ,[industrial](https://www.azz.com/industrial-market) , and[transportation](https://www.azz.com/transportation-market) markets critical to modern infrastructure and manufacturing throughout North America. Applications include bridges, substations, utility transmission and distribution infrastructure, light poles, datacenters, airports, stadiums, industrial facilities, transportation infrastructure, renewable energy and energy storage projects, fabricated steel components, water infrastructure, and engineered products requiring durable corrosion protection and dependable coating performance.


With industry-leading galvanizing expertise, specialized Surface Technologies, technology-driven operations, and one of North America’s largest metal coating networks, AZZ delivers integrated coating solutions engineered to improve durability, production efficiency, and infrastructure reliability across essential applications.
